note: National parliamentary (lower house) and direct presidential elections since 1945, newest first. parties: top 8 by vote share (or seats) plus Others; share = % of valid votes, seats = seats won. Parliament elections up to 2023 in ParlGov countries come from ParlGov; later ones and all others from Wikidata, whose party results are incomplete for many countries (parties may be [] or shares null). Presidential results are the deciding round where Wikidata stores rounds; decided:false marks a presidential election whose deciding round is pending or not recorded (shares are then the latest round on record). US presidential popular vote from MEDSL. Turnout = ballots cast / registered voters (ParlGov: votes_cast / electorate). family is Orbis' grouping of ParlGov party families or Wikidata political alignment (P1387).
